stem: Which statement best describes how investment in the stock market during the mid-to-late 1920s contributed to the Great Depression?

options.label: F
options.text: People were unable to repay the loans used to purchase stocks.

options.label: G
options.text: Government taxes on stock transactions made it difficult to repay investors.

options.label: H
options.text: Financial institutions were not required to report earnings to stock investors.

options.label: J
options.text: Foreign countries were not required to immediately pay stockholder earnings.
